definitions.full: H1025. Beth Haemeq הָעֵ֫מֶק בֵּית proper name, of a location on border of Asher ( valley-house ) Josh 19:27 . Survey i. 145 compare `Amka , 7 miles northeast of Akko (but see Rob BR iii. 103, 108 ).
